restrictions: Use only 40-byte messages, the standard fixed IV, SHA-256 indices 0 through 30 on the single padded block, full feed-forward, and the full 256-bit digest.

For exactly 2^128 samples draw two fresh independent uniform 256-bit RAM words; use the first whole word and the low 64 bits of the second to form each message. Deterministic seed expansion is not a substitute.

Use three-word (digest, x, z) records, two stable counting-sort passes on the low then high 128 digest bits, and a full adjacent collision scan; require distinct messages and verify a returned pair by complete re-hashing.

Charge all record generation, sorting, failed attempts, scan, random draws, preprocessing, instruction fetches, and verification under collision-frontier-v5. Preprocessing is inside total time; zero actual nonuniform advice is bounded by the schema's one-byte convention.
This is a distribution-free analytic birthday construction with no experiments, computed witness, hidden precomputed search, or claim of improvement over the nominal 128 reference.
